description:
Born the granddaughter of a shaman, Go Bok-Sil. Her grandmother, who often found herself alone, decided to offer a final prayer before passing away: "Please give me the one who will make Bok-Sil happy!" But there was no word from her destined one. So, Bok-Sil set out to find what she loved. A prop shop she'd opened in the shaman's home. Friendly customers and wonderful friends. And then there was the baseball team, Taeyang Wales, and the hitter, Yun Cheong-Il. Bok-Sil went to the baseball stadium to cheer on her favorite team. That day, Cheong-Il's home run ball was uncannily beautiful. As if possessed, she rushed to catch the ball, only to collide with an unknown man. And with that, an unbelievable transformation unfolded...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*
